content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

No non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restraint binds Northwind. Section 12.3 goes further than mere silence by affirmatively confirming Customer may develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and conduct business in any field or territory, and that no exclusivity/non-compete/MFC/minimum-volume/no-hire commitment has been made.

Other locations checked and cleared:
- **12.4** — competing-product covenant binds *Vendor* in our favour; not flagged.
- **13.4** — reverse-engineering/acceptable-use limits are ordinary licence-scope terms, expressly not limiting Customer Data and output.
- **24 (p0100)** — assignment restriction on Vendor re Customer competitors; runs in our favour.
- **26, 30** — no restrictive covenants.

No redline proposed.
